title: feat(gantt): feature parity Phases 1-5 — links, time scales, hierarchy, interactions, virtualization
body:
Implements Phases 1–5 of the Gantt feature-parity roadmap ([`packages/plugin-gantt/ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/feat/gantt-dependency-links/packages/plugin-gantt/ROADMAP.md)). Feature set referenced against svar-widgets/react-gantt (GPLv3 — feature reference only, all code written from scratch under MIT).

## Progress

- [x] **Phase 1 — Dependency links** (0d9cba15e): SVG overlay with orthogonal arrows, all 4 link types (`fs`/`ss`/`ff`/`sf`), live tracking during drag/resize, hover highlight, `normalizeDependencies` export
- [x] **Phase 2 — Real time scales** (ff776f16c): day/week/month/quarter, two-row header, weekend tint, zoom, jump-to-today
- [x] **Phase 3 — Hierarchy** (45a2a41ea): collapsible tree, bracket summary bars, milestone diamonds, treeitem a11y
- [x] **Phase 4 — Interaction polish** (9796aa24d): progress drag handle, tooltip, context menu, keyboard nav, inline edit, drag-to-create links, row reorder
- [x] **Phase 5 — Scale** (5971ee039): virtualized rows *and* columns, fullscreen toggle, custom timeline markers
- [x] **Self-testing** (80d3bdd81, d47a78846): 60 unit tests + automated browser verification with persisted screenshots
- [ ] Phase 6 — not in scope for this PR

## Self-test results (real Chromium, screenshots committed)

`scripts/verify-browser.mjs` drives the new `demo/` app and persists screenshots to [`docs/verification/`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/tree/feat/gantt-dependency-links/packages/plugin-gantt/docs/verification) — **18/18 checks passed**:

- **Links**: 10 arrows covering all 4 types; hover highlights exactly the hovered bar's links; real-mouse drag from a link dot creates a new dependency (rubber band asserted mid-drag)
- **Hierarchy**: 13 rows / 3 summary brackets / 2 milestones; collapsing *Build* hides its 4 children and their links; expand restores
- **Performance (5,000 tasks)**: initial render **27 ms**, only **26 rows + 26 columns** in the DOM (spacer-based windowing), mid-list scroll window shift **40.5 ms**

Browser testing also caught (and this PR fixes) utilities missing from the prebuilt `@object-ui/components/style.css` — summary brackets, the Today marker, weekend tint, row hover/selection and the drag ring were invisible in consuming apps and now use inline theme-var colors.

## Validation

- `pnpm vitest run` (plugin-gantt): 60 tests passing; monorepo-wide: 3,600 tests / 220 files green
- `pnpm type-check`: full turbo run green (58 tasks)
- Browser: 18/18 automated checks, screenshots in `docs/verification/`

> Do not merge — per request, this PR stays open for review.
